title: OA SUBDUING OPPONENTS - the subdual doctrine: the intelligence gate with the genius clause, the quarter damage split, the starting-hit-point surrender threshold and the oath mechanics
audit_comment: OA round seventy-three (capture pp. 221-222): the Subduing Opponents doctrine - the intelligence gate, the quarter damage split with the starting-hit-point surrender threshold, the normal-damage voiding, the oath mechanics and the captive clause, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA SUBDUING OPPONENTS, printed capture pp. 221-222 - the subdual doctrine round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE DOCTRINE: defeating an opponent without killing him - the shukenja class normally forbidden from killing, the prisoners and hostages useful only alive. THE GATES: subdual only against creatures of at least low Intelligence, the genius-rated subdued only by voluntary surrender, any creature or NPC in scope - but a player character NEVER forced, the surrender the player's choice. THE MECHANICS: the fight-start declaration, the blunt edge, flat, haft, butt, pommel or hilt striking, each blow normal but only 1/4 costing hit points, the 3/4 recorded separately as subdual - the surrender when subdual exceeds the STARTING hit points; any normal-damage attack voiding all subdual points. THE SURRENDER: stop fighting and drop weapons; the exactable oath with the secret honor roll or the save versus death - compliance or the show of agreement; the captive seeking the first escape. The prose codifies per the R431 calculus

consts.name: dizOASubdualHitLossNum
consts.comment: the subdual hit-point loss numerator - damage from each blow determined normally but only 1/4 of it causing a loss of hit points (print capture p. 222)

consts.name: dizOASubdualHitLossDen
consts.comment: the subdual hit-point loss denominator - the quarter share of normal damage that costs hit points (print capture p. 222)

consts.name: dizOASubdualDamageNum
consts.comment: the subdual damage numerator - the remaining 3/4 of each blow recorded as subdual damage (print capture p. 222)

consts.name: dizOASubdualDamageDen
consts.comment: the subdual damage denominator - the three-quarter share of each blow carried as subdual damage, recorded separately from the hit points lost (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: dizOASubdualDoctrine
bools.comment: the doctrine frame - sometimes desirable to defeat an opponent without killing him, particularly true of the shukenja character class normally forbidden from killing, and of the need to take prisoners or a hostage, both useful only when alive (print capture p. 221)

bools.name: dizOASubdualIntelligenceGate
bools.comment: the intelligence gate - subdual can only be used against creatures with at least a modicum of Intelligence, at least the low Intelligence rating (print capture p. 221)

bools.name: dizOASubdualGeniusVoluntary
bools.comment: the genius clause - those of genius Intelligence or greater can only be subdued if they voluntarily decide to surrender, knowing too well the fate that awaits most prisoners (print capture p. 221)

bools.name: dizOASubdualAnyCreature
bools.comment: the scope rule - subdual can be used against any kind of creature or NPC (print capture p. 221)

bools.name: dizOASubdualPCNeverForced
bools.comment: the player-choice rule - a player character can never be forced into submission; player characters may decide to surrender but the choice is left to the player (print capture p. 221)

bools.name: dizOASubdualMustDeclare
bools.comment: the declaration rule - players must declare any subdual attempt at the beginning of the fight, the attackers then assumed to be striking with the blunt edge, flat, haft, butt, pommel or hilt of their weapon (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: dizOASubdualDamageNormal
bools.comment: the normal-damage roll - damage from each blow determined normally, only the quarter share costing hit points (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: dizOASubdualRecordedSeparately
bools.comment: the separate record - subdual damage recorded separately from the hit points lost (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: dizOASubdualSurrenderAtStartHP
bools.comment: the surrender threshold - the being subdued and surrendering when the subdual damage exceeds the total STARTING hit points (not the current hit points) of the creature or character (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: dizOASubdualNormalDamageVoids
bools.comment: the voiding rule - if any attack is made on the being for normal damage after the declaration to subdue, the creature will not surrender: all subdual points disappear and the creature is fought normally (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: dizOASubduedMustStop
bools.comment: the subdued state - a subdued creature must stop fighting and drop its weapons (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: dizOASubdualOathCheck
bools.comment: the oath mechanics - if the players can communicate, they can exact an oath (a task or promise); the DM secretly rolls against the creature's honor if it has honor points, or makes a saving throw versus death - equal or less than the honor, or a failed save, means compliance; otherwise a show of agreeing while hoping for vengeance later (print capture p. 222)

bools.name: dizOASubdualCaptiveEscape
bools.comment: the captive clause - alternatively the victor can keep the creature captive, it seeking the first opportunity to escape, humble and docile only as long as the captors maintain the upper hand (print capture p. 222)

examples.note: the quarter split - the 1/4 hit-point loss against the 3/4 subdual share
